doc.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I’ve really enjoyed talking to you and I wish you the best in your career, and we’ll do this again a few years from now maybe and see what’s going on.
I’ve enjoyed talking to you to, you had great questions.
Well on behalf of Hamilton College, I’d like to thank Jon-Erik Kellso for being with us, and I hope you have a great gig and no one calls too many tunes that you don’t know.
Okay. Good luck to you. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
